title: havana chops, then the wave falls to a line
story: 72 Hacheros Pa' Un Palo is a slow cha-cha at 86 BPM (the tracker's beat is 22.3 ticks; the onset-autocorrelation peaks at a 15-tick lag, the cha-cha eighths). Before 6603 each bright stroke chops the wave (grosor 0.2 to 0.42 and a shake), the stabs lift the brightness and contrast, and every two beats the wave count steps 3.0 to 3.4, on the havana brown tint that moves each bar. From 6603 the anomaly doubles the hits: the two triples at 6696-6711 and 6718-6733 (the third hit of each the strongest) spike the amplitude to 0.45 and the grosor to 0.55 with the shake, and the wave count swings 2.6 to 3.4. At 6781 the RMS drops; the 6835 chord is the one hard flash (col_bri 1.6, contrast 0.6), and after 6848 the wave collapses with the RMS to a flat thin line that stays.
